title: Is the Pink Substance Dropped on LA Fires Safe?
titleZh: 洛杉矶山火中喷洒的粉色物质安全吗？
credits: Huw Griffith and Sarah Titterton reported this story for Agence France-Presse. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: The efforts to battle widespread fires across Los Angeles included aircraft drops of a bright red and pink substance.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶地区扑灭肆虐大火的行动中，出动飞机投放了一种鲜红与粉红相间的物质。

sentences.en: The material covered forests, homes, cars, and other things in the path of the wind-fueled fires.
sentences.zh: 这种物质覆盖了风助火势的火灾路径上的森林、房屋、汽车及其他物品。

sentences.en: Because the substance was dropped in many residential areas, some people have wondered how safe it is.
sentences.zh: 由于该物质被投放到多个居民区，一些人开始质疑它是否安全。

sentences.en: The material is a fire retardant.
sentences.zh: 这种物质是一种阻燃剂。

sentences.en: The kind dropped around Los Angeles was mostly a product called Phos-Chek.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶周边投放的这种物质主要是名为Phos-Chek的产品。

sentences.en: The substance has been used by the U.S. Forest Service to fight fires since the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪60年代起，美国林务局就开始使用这种物质来灭火。

sentences.en: Jason Colquhoun is a 53-year-old pilot with HeliQwest, an aircraft company specializing in firefighting activities.
sentences.zh: 杰森·科尔奎恩是HeliQwest公司的53岁飞行员，这是一家专门从事消防作业的航空公司。

sentences.en: He told the French news agency Agence France-Presse (AFP) that using the Barbie-pink material makes his job easier.
sentences.zh: 他告诉法新社（AFP），使用芭比粉红色的物质让他的工作更容易。

sentences.en: "You can see it so easily ... it's amazing," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：'你可以很容易地看到它……太神奇了。'

sentences.en: Daniel McCurry is an associate professor of civil and environmental engineering at the University of Southern California.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·麦库里是南加州大学土木与环境工程系的副教授。

sentences.en: He said that in recent weeks, Phos-Chek had been dropped in residential areas more than ever before.
sentences.zh: 他表示，近几周来，Phos-Chek 阻燃剂被投放到居民区的次数前所未有。

sentences.en: That fact has led many to question its safety.
sentences.zh: 这一事实引发了许多人对其安全性的质疑。

sentences.en: Phos-Chek is sold by fire protection equipment supplier Perimeter Solutions.
sentences.zh: Phos-Chek 由消防设备供应商 Perimeter Solutions 销售。

sentences.en: It is a mixture of mostly ammonium phosphate or ammonium polyphosphate.
sentences.zh: 它主要由磷酸铵或聚磷酸铵混合而成。

sentences.en: These substances are also used to produce fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 这些物质也用于生产化肥。

sentences.en: Other chemicals are added to the mixture to give it color.
sentences.zh: 混合物中还会添加其他化学物质以赋予其颜色。

sentences.en: Perimeter told AFP the substance is designed to be one color.
sentences.zh: Perimeter 向法新社表示，该物质被设计成单一颜色。

sentences.en: But it can look different depending on time of day, lighting, or smoke.
sentences.zh: 但它看起来可能因时间、光线或烟雾的不同而有所差异。

sentences.en: The bright pink color helps pilots as they try to make sure they have covered a whole area, Colquhoun explained.
sentences.zh: 科克洪解释说，这种鲜艳的粉红色有助于飞行员在努力确认是否已覆盖整个区域时进行判断。

sentences.en: He noted that when pilots drop water from the air, they have to search for "the shine and the darkness" to know where to make the next drop.
sentences.zh: 他指出，当飞行员从空中投放水时，他们必须寻找"反光与暗影"以确定下一次投放的位置。

sentences.en: The colorful retardant, however, is "so much easier to spot," Colquhoun said.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种色彩鲜艳的阻燃剂"更容易被找到"，科尔奎恩说道。

sentences.en: McCurry said another reason it is better than water is that it keeps working even after the water it is mixed with dries.
sentences.zh: 麦库里表示，另一个它优于水的原因是，即使其中混合的水分已经干涸，它依然能够持续发挥作用。

sentences.en: Phos-Chek is made thick so the wind does not blow it away and to ensure that it covers the desired area.
sentences.zh: 菲索塞克阻燃剂被调配得很浓稠，这样风就不会把它吹走，也能确保它覆盖到预定区域。

sentences.en: McCurry explained the substance works by forming a coating that will not burn.
sentences.zh: 麦库里解释了这种物质的作用原理，即形成一层不会燃烧的涂层。

sentences.en: After the water dries up, the retardant keeps working until rain washes it into the ground.
sentences.zh: 水分蒸发后，阻燃剂会持续发挥作用，直到雨水将其冲入地下。

sentences.en: McCurry said a former firefighter told him that in a high-intensity fire the substance is "not much use."
sentences.zh: 麦库里说，一名前消防员曾告诉他，在火势猛烈的火灾中，这种物质"没什么用。"

sentences.en: He added that the high winds driving the fires in Los Angeles may have limited its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 他还补充说，驱动洛杉矶火灾的强风可能限制了它的效果。

sentences.en: U.S. Forest Service spokesperson Wade Muehlhof said the agency only uses retardants that meet U.S. government rules for not being harmful to animals, humans, or things living in water.
sentences.zh: 美国林务局发言人韦德·穆尔霍夫表示，该机构只使用符合美国政府关于不对动物、人类或水中生物造成危害规定的阻燃剂。

sentences.en: He told AFP the Forest Service usually does not drop the retardant in waterways and areas home to endangered animals -- unless the fire is threatening human life or public safety.
sentences.zh: 他告诉法新社，林务局通常不会在水道和濒危动物栖息地投放阻燃剂——除非火灾正在威胁人类生命或公共安全。

sentences.en: But accidents do happen, he said, and the wind may blow it into such areas.
sentences.zh: 不过他说，事故确实会发生，而且风可能把它吹进这些区域。

sentences.en: McCurry said he believes Phos-Chek is “likely not harmless to the environment” now.
sentences.zh: 麦库里表示，他认为菲索塞克阻燃剂"现在很可能对环境无害"。

sentences.en: But, he added, "On the other hand, the human health impact is still a little unclear."
sentences.zh: 不过，他补充道，"另一方面，对人类健康的影响仍然有些不明朗。"

sentences.en: He noted that it would take "a lot" of retardant to poison, say, a large body of water.
sentences.zh: 他指出，要毒害一大片水域，比如说，需要"大量"的阻燃剂。

sentences.en: But he said that as firefighters battled the Los Angeles fires, the substance was dropped on a lot of neighborhoods in “unprecedented” amounts.
sentences.zh: 不过他说，当消防员 battling 洛杉矶火灾时，这种物质以"史无前例"的量被投放到了许多社区。

sentences.en: McCurry said Phos-Chek is more often used further from populated areas, or in lesser amounts.
sentences.zh: 麦库里说，菲索塞k阻燃剂更多被用于远离人口密集区的地区，或者用量较少。

sentences.en: "So, who knows," he added.
sentences.zh: "所以，谁知道呢，"他说道。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

glossary.def: something that is able to slow down the progress or development of something
a thin layer of material that covers the surface of something
a powerful or major influence or effect
